steps: All six explicit directions have independent exact right/up/back GPU matrix witnesses and enclose every rotated corner at the real drawing-buffer aspect. Draft and saved source bytes are unchanged.
Standard directions frame the whole model even with zero search matches, preserving hidden selected identity and its inspector.

At both exact poles, a real wheel preserves axis orientation, single/all focus still works, actual canvas mouse selection reaches the intended box, and pointer dragging yields finite new views. Reset restores original authored GPU matrices.
An invalid edited source keeps native diagnostics and disables exact source location; standard directions continue on the last valid model without saving or clearing that diagnostic.

A new unsaved model uses its complete new bounds. Chinese, English and Japanese at 390px preserve the standard-direction controls, source text and scrollable controls; all 24 corners fit each actual resized GPU viewport.
Closing disposes the view. Reopening reads the current unsaved draft and frames it; author files retain their original bytes throughout.
Injected WebGL unavailability disables only view controls, keeps verified declarations and does not change author files.
limitations: Real HTTP editor, native/WASM source semantics and WebGL2 draws/readPixels; no installed desktop, Android or hardware-GPU claim.

Chrome flags and renderer/vendor are recorded explicitly. This run pins ANGLE/SwiftShader; the automatic headless fallback exhibited compositor corruption in a separate retained comparison. No hardware-GPU claim.
Unsupported-renderer phase injects getContext(webgl2)=null only; all source semantics and editor Save remain real.
Six standard directions only navigate the last valid preview; no author camera or source writes. Instrumentation records actual uploaded matrices and forwards WebGL calls unchanged.
